### Covered population
- Medicare beneficiaries with a diagnosis of diabetes mellitus supported by an ICD-10-CM code in Section 5, age 18 or older on the date of service, who are treated with insulin.

### Coverage criteria
All of the following must be met and documented in the medical record:
- Diabetes diagnosis supported by one of the listed ICD-10-CM codes.
- Age 18 or older on the date of service.
- Insulin treatment by multiple daily injections (three or more per day) or by a continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion pump.
- Minimum of 4 fingerstick blood glucose tests per day, documented in the treating practitioner's records.
- In-person visit with the treating practitioner within the 6 months prior to the written order.
- Beneficiary or caregiver trained on the device, attested to by the supplier.
- Documented failure of prior therapy: inadequate glycemic control on a fingerstick-guided regimen over a trial of at least 3 months.

### Exclusions
- Diabetes managed by diet, exercise, or oral agents alone with no insulin therapy.
- Gestational diabetes and prediabetes.
- More than one CGM receiver per beneficiary per five years absent loss or irreparable damage.
- Supplies billed in excess of one month supply per month.
- Any claim that does not meet the Section 1 criteria, denied as not reasonable and necessary.

### Relevant codes
- HCPCS: `K0554` receiver, `K0553` therapeutic CGM supply allowance, `A4239` non-adjunctive CGM supply allowance, `E2103` non-adjunctive CGM or receiver.
- ICD-10-CM: `E10.9`, `E11.9`, `E11.65`, `E13.9`.
- HCPCS outside Section 4 are denied as not covered. The KX modifier applies only when every Section 1 criterion is met and documented.
